$comment: Verdicts for imports found in Convex "use node" files, from docs/spikes/node-actions/RESULTS.md (workerd, compatibility_date 2026-10-01, nodejs_compat, Ember's Worker bundler as of this spike). For `ember migrate convex` (PLAN §22 L9/L13): match an import specifier against `modules` (exact `node:` name, bare builtin name, or npm package name / subpath prefix, longest match wins) and print `verdict` + `note`. Thresholds are rows × 20 columns at a 128 MB V8 heap; the isolate is shared by concurrent requests, so budget about half. `evidence`: "tested" = run in this spike; "inferred" = from the probes above (native addons, code generation, sockets) or Cloudflare's docs, not run.

verdicts.works: Runs in an Ember action as is.
verdicts.partial: Runs, with a size limit or a caveat (see note): check the workload.
verdicts.no: Cannot run in the Worker: needs a workaround, another service or a container (future `action({ runtime: "container" })`).

node:crypto.note: createHash/Hmac, randomUUID/randomBytes, pbkdf2, scrypt, ed25519/RSA keys, sign/verify, AES-GCM, webcrypto. cipher.update(string) needs an explicit encoding: pass a Buffer or 'utf8'.

node:fs.note: Virtual file system: /tmp is writable and per request, /bundle is read-only; no access to the deploy machine's files. Store files with ctx.storage (R2).

node:os.note: Stubs: cpus() is empty, totalmem() is 0.

node:http.note: Client requests work (over fetch); servers do not listen. Prefer fetch.

node:https.note: Client requests work (over fetch). Prefer fetch.

node:net.note: Outbound TCP via Workers sockets only; no servers.

node:dns.note: Lookups go over DNS-over-HTTPS (not verified in this spike).

node:process.note: process.env holds Worker vars/secrets; memoryUsage() returns zeros.

node:child_process.note: Not implemented in Workers: no subprocesses (LibreOffice, ImageMagick, ffmpeg, Python...). Container work (future).

node:worker_threads.note: Not implemented. Split the work into scheduled actions.

node:vm.note: No code generation from strings (eval/new Function are blocked too).

node:sqlite.note: Use the shard's tables (ctx.db) or ctx.sql.

exceljs.note: In-memory read fits ~25k rows (OOM at 30k), in-memory write ~10k (OOM at 15k). Streaming reader (exceljs/lib/exceljs.nodejs.js, needs the bundler fix): feed it the file with the worksheets moved to the end of the zip (RESULTS.md §5, src/xlsx-sheets-last.js): 200k rows in 3.9 s, OOM ~390k; without that it spools to /tmp (quadratic in workerd: 100k rows = 32 s CPU). Streaming writer fails (`input source must be valid Stream or Buffer instance`, readable-stream's browser build): export CSV, or SheetJS up to ~25k rows.

xlsx.note: SheetJS (npm 0.18.5): read fits ~35k rows (OOM at 40k), write ~25k (OOM at 30k). 0.20.3 from cdn.sheetjs.com with `dense: true` reads ~45k. No streaming XLSX reader.

papaparse.note: Whole-string parse fits ~100k rows; streaming (`step` + pause/resume over the R2 body) is flat in memory at any size. Recipe in RESULTS.md §5.

csv-parse.note: Not measured; streaming CSV parsers behave like papaparse's stream mode.

pdf-lib.note: Generate ~2,000 pages of text (OOM at 2,500); load + stamp 5,000 pages. Standard fonts; custom fonts need @pdf-lib/fontkit (not measured).

pdfjs-dist.note: Text extraction with pdfjs-dist/legacy/build/pdf.mjs after importing pdf.worker.mjs (in-thread worker), isEvalSupported: false: ~4,500 pages (OOM at 5,000), ~0.6 ms/page. No rendering to images (no canvas).

jszip.note: Works after the bundler fix (it failed to build before). Zip fits ~4,000 × 10 KB files (OOM at 4,500); unzip of 5,000 files OK. ~6x slower than Node in wall time (setTimeout yields between entries; CPU is low). Prefer fflate.

fflate.note: zipSync/unzipSync of 200 MB OK under the heap cap (data in ArrayBuffers: whether production counts them is unverified); streaming Unzip over the R2 body is flat.

stripe.note: Fetch client picked by the workerd export; webhooks: constructEventAsync + createSubtleCryptoProvider().

@aws-sdk/client-s3.note: Needs the bundler fix of this spike (before it threw `emitWarningIfUnsupportedVersion is not a function`). For the app's own files use ctx.storage (R2).

sharp.note: Native addon. Use ctx.images (Cloudflare Images) for resize/convert.

puppeteer.note: Use ctx.browser (Browser Rendering, PLAN §13) or @cloudflare/puppeteer through ctx.browser.binding.

bcrypt.note: Native addon. Use node:crypto scrypt (native in workerd) or bcryptjs.

ajv.note: Compiles validators with new Function, which workerd blocks at request time: precompile (ajv standalone) or validate with v.* validators.
